rationale: PV-only candidates curated from prior WQ-platform mining rounds. All fields (returns/close/vwap) have 100% coverage on TOP200/500/1000 by construction, so the platform concentration check ('Weight is too strongly concentrated') cannot trigger from sparse data — which was the blocker for the IV+ROA factor family (R56-R62). Sharpe / turnover values below are from WQ Brain platform simulation, not local backtest.

candidates.rationale: Tail-trimmed reversal: short the top 15% by 252-day rank-of-returns, long the bottom 15%. Quantile gating throttles trading to extreme names, lowering turnover.
Continuous version of PV1: negative 200-day rank-of-returns, neutralized by subindustry. Simpler, less hyperparameter risk.

Stacked decay × negative rank of second-difference of close. Different alpha source (price acceleration, not level reversal) so combines well with PV1/PV2 in a portfolio. Turnover 0.10 is the lowest in the pool.

submission_order: 1. PV1 first (highest Sharpe, proven low turnover, quantile-gated → robust to noise).
2. PV2 as backup (simpler, easier to defend to a reviewer).
3. PV3 if portfolio diversity matters (orthogonal alpha source, lowest TO).
